missing_evidence: Heap dump or allocation-site profile to confirm leak vs. benign growth
Sustained retention trend over a longer window to confirm unbounded growth
candidates.statement: Order service shows sustained memory retention: retained_bytes rose from 49.3MB to 81.3MB across 5 samples with positive net allocations (1800) and no reclamation after GC, plus 7 WARN retained_heap_after_gc log events. This is the only service with anomalous memory behavior; gateway, payment and inventory are flat.
candidates.uncertainty: Retained bytes remain well below the 160MB limit and p95 latency is normal (72ms), so user-visible impact is not yet established.

report.explanation: Order is the only service with anomalous memory telemetry: monotonic retained_bytes growth, positive net allocations, no post-GC reclamation, and retained_heap_after_gc WARN logs. Other services are flat and healthy. Deployment record alone does not establish causation. Bounded candidate is a memory leak in order; impact on checkout latency is not yet demonstrated.
